plugins.name: recording-browser-walkthroughs
plugins.description: Record internal walkthrough videos of any app running locally in a browser: captions, click boxes, callouts, chapter cards and jumps, drawn in the page by a Playwright kit, out as 1080p MP4 with chapters. App specifics (navigation, login, data changes) come in as adapter hooks.
